description: Renovate policy for wraithbox/wraithbox; see docs/spec/S02-toolchain.md, "Dependency updates". Run by .github/workflows/renovate.yml.

packageRules.description: The macOS runner is the oldest v1 host on purpose (S02-toolchain, "Swift comes from Xcode, not mise", NFR04-host-platforms), so it moves only when that host does, by hand.

A new Ubuntu runner image (24.04 -> 26.04) is proposed as soon as GitHub marks it stable, without automerge: PR CI only exercises ci.yml, not fuzz.yml, deploy.yml or this repository's renovate.yml, so the maintainer merges it after a manual run of those.
Never move TypeScript to a new major (6 -> 7 needs the maintainer's explicit agreement; `astro check` needs the TypeScript 6 API: https://github.com/withastro/roadmap/discussions/1321).

Lock file maintenance has no release timestamp, and by default (timestamp-required) a minimumReleaseAge without a timestamp is pending forever, so it never automerges. The transitives it pulls in are aged by each ecosystem's own cooldown (packages/wraithbox-doc/bunfig.toml, mise minimum_release_age).

Overrides in packages/wraithbox-doc/package.json are hand-maintained advisory floors ("fast-uri": "^3.1.9"), not dependencies: pinning would turn the floor into an exact version, and a major would leave the parents' range. Renovate's vulnerability fixes still raise them when an advisory needs it.

zizmor-action's version input is looked up on GHCR, which has no release timestamps (so no 7-day wait). Look it up on zizmor's GitHub releases instead: the same 7-day wait as the mise zizmor pin, so both land in the same non-major PR, as .github/workflows/ci.yml requires.

Renovate's own image (in .github/workflows/renovate.yml and the renovate:validate task in .mise.toml) is on GHCR, which has no release timestamps, so the 7-day wait would not apply. Look it up on npm instead, which has them; same versions.

customManagers.description: The go directive of go.work, an exact pin that must equal the mise go pin and the go.mod go directive (S02-toolchain, "Native pin files"). All three are non-major updates of go, so group:allNonMajor puts them in one PR.
Renovate's image (`ghcr.io/renovatebot/renovate:<version>`) in the workflow that runs it and in the renovate:validate task. Both must be the same version.
